mathematical_result.statement: For T=A(h.Y+S)^2+2d U(g0 X+g.Y)+F with X cap-one, Y an independent cap-one product bank, U an independent-background marginal of density cap L, g0!=0, and max_j h_j^2/||h||^2<=1/2, one has |phi_T(t)|<=min(1,K/|t|), K=2*pi*sqrt(L)/(||h||*sqrt(|A*d*g0|)). Hence int|phi|^2<=4K, ||p_T||_2^2<=2K/pi, and int|t|^-1/2|phi|^2<=(16/3)sqrt(K).
mathematical_result.target_normalized_consequence: At exact heavy-row angular cancellation h_r=0 in the one-sided exact-rank-three packet, the still-unpaid heavy-set geometry makes the remaining square bank 1D-diffuse and gives int|phi_Q|^2<54.27326850232713/s3(A), ||p_Q||_2^2<8.637858959899031/s3(A), and linear collision P(|Q-Q'|<=eps)<17.27571791979806*s3(A)^(-1)*eps, uniformly as the outer pivot a tends to zero.
mathematical_result.continuity: not proved; phi is L2 but the envelope is critical 1/|t|, not L1
